ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
fun isLastDateOfMonth(date: Date) = (date + |P1D|).day == 1
fun getPreviousMonthLastDate(date: Date) = (date as String {format: "yyyy-MM-01"} as Date) - |P1D|
fun getCurrentMonthStartDate(date: Date) = date as String {format: "yyyy-MM-01"} as Date
fun getCurrentMonthPreviousDate(date: Date) = date as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} as Date - |P1D|
var inputDate = vars.inventoryDate var parsedDate = inputDate as Date {format: "d-MMM-yyyy"} var previousMonthLastDate = getPreviousMonthLastDate(parsedDate) var currentMonthStartDate = getCurrentMonthStartDate(parsedDate) var currentMonthPreviousDate = getCurrentMonthStartDate(parsedDate)
--- { "currentDate": parsedDate, "previousDate": getCurrentMonthPreviousDate(parsedDate) as String {format: "d-MMM-yyyy"}, "isLastDateOfMonth": isLastDateOfMonth(parsedDate), "isStartMonthDate": parsedDate.day == 1, // true if day is 1, false otherwise "previousMonthLastDate": previousMonthLastDate as String {format: "d-MMM-yyyy"}, "currentMonthStartDate": currentMonthStartDate as String {format: "d-MMM-yyyy"}, "date": parsedDate as String {format: "d-MMM-yyyy"}, "month": upper(parsedDate as String {format: "MMM"}), "previousMonth": upper(previousMonthLastDate as String {format: "MMM"}), "weekday": parsedDate as String {format: "EEEE"}, "currentNumberOfDays": parsedDate.day, "year": parsedDate as String {format: "yyyy"} // Added last two digits of year }
